blocks.text: A quick update while it is fresh. Kimberly Le finished the coverage read this morning. Three themes are carrying most of the {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} story at the moment. None is a surprise, but one runs louder than we expected. We are writing the whole picture up as a short findings note so you see the evidence, not just my read of it.

Before we take that to interviews, a working session with you would help. Half an hour to walk the themes, agree what matters, and set the questions we put to people. I can bring the Gallegos, Pope and Marsh coverage grid so we are all looking at the same page.
I will send you two or three times for that session, Robert Smith, later today; pick whichever suits and we will hold it.
